summary: Place authored polycube pieces into a small grid volume using exact occupied cells.
objective: Create a small voxel packing puzzle with pieces I can rotate by quarter turns and place into a tray.
example_prompts: Create a small voxel packing puzzle with pieces I can rotate by quarter turns and place into a tray.
Highlight exactly which grid cells conflict before I commit a piece.

entities.name: Pieces
entities.guidance: Build each rigid piece from an explicit connected set of integer cells; merge internal faces where useful.

entities.name: Tray
entities.guidance: Show boundary frame, floor grid and target volume outline with an optional sliced layer view.

object_craft.structure: Build each rigid piece from an explicit connected set of integer cells; merge internal faces where useful.
object_craft.material: Distinct matte colors with subtle bevels that do not change logical occupancy.

object_craft.structure: Show boundary frame, floor grid and target volume outline with an optional sliced layer view.

state_contract.model: Authored finite cell set per piece, integer translation, allowed proper axis-aligned orientations and target cell set; committed occupancy is exact.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Rotate selected piece by a quarter turn.
Undo placement and request a checked hint.

invariants: Accepted pieces occupy disjoint cells entirely inside target volume.
Solved means occupied target set equals required set exactly.
Four quarter turns return the same oriented cell set; visual rounding does not change rules.
motion_guidance: Animate between discrete orientations but commit only after interpolation completes.
During preview keep ghost occupancy distinct from committed board state.
known_limits: Authored puzzle instance requires a verified solution path before advertising solvability.
No commercial puzzle reproduction, gravity or friction simulation; solver hints need actual search results.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Beveled pieces and layer slicing make depth readable while exact cells keep validation simple.

physical_contract.scope: Discrete occupancy puzzle, not rigid-body packing.
colliders: Exact integer cell sets rather than mesh collision.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Undo restores occupancy; solved check compares full cell sets.
